b) just get it if considering it

MORE:

1. If I could only buy (or get free) one non-tangible-utility-required app? I just scanned my app list...THIS is it. I can't imagine giving it up.

 If you'ure considering it ... get it and see (can do monthly "subscription" I can't recall what free version does since immediately dove in with yearly great deal).

3) Building on my #2 above, Portal significantly upgraded my quality of life. Whether working (focused, less stress, imporved mood, creative thinking) or even when not on the computer at all! (I'll run it on the monitor for the mood of the room!)

4) There's a growing but huge array of these live-feeling video-with-sound "portals" as if it's your view IRL (bigger screen; way bigger effect...my 27" is awesome). 6. There are ways to integrate with "smart lighting" for "even more" immersion. IF you don't those know it's not necessary and doesn't affect my strong (!!!) recommendation of this app...consider it a bonus if you do.

There's many types and ways and they evolve and expanded over time. Currently I use Nanoleaf's desktop app with beta updates (not sure if that's required) to mirror the colors in different ways from my montor running the "Portal" to my Nanoleaf "Essentials" (bulbs mostly) in same area as screen.

7. I am so "immersed" in Portal it (almost) became "invsible" it's part of simply how I use my computer. Remembered...it's an app! And so definitely wanted to come back here and tell you about my experience adding my "review" so "you" will be more likely to see/hear about it and get to eperience it, too.

title.label: Transformative App for focus, relaxation, and sleep management

content.label:
As someone grappling with narcolepsy, finding an effective tool to manage my condition has always been a challenge. This app has been nothing short of a revelation, profoundly impacting my daily routine and overall quality of life.

Just recently, I was struggling to take a short nap, a critical aspect of managing my narcolepsy. The app’s feature of guiding breathing exercises for two minutes transported me to a serene state, reminiscent of my tranquil visit to the Botallack mines. Remarkably, I achieved eight minutes of REM sleep in an 18-minute nap, awakening refreshed and ready to cherish the day with my son.

Moreover, the app proved its worth yet again during a night spent away from home, amidst a different time zone, which usually exacerbates my sleep challenges. However, the app’s soothing features and exceptionally gentle alarm facilitated a restful sleep, enabling me to wake up rejuvenated for my morning class. The anticipation of experiencing the app’s lighting features adds to my excitement, promising an even more holistic relaxation experience.

This app is a game-changer, not just for individuals seeking a momentary escape or focus, but also for those like me, navigating the complexities of narcolepsy. It has also served as a wonderful tool in spending calming moments with my special needs child, enhancing our quality time together.

I wholeheartedly recommend this app to anyone in search of a reliable companion for relaxation, sleep management, or simply to find a peaceful moment in a hectic day. Its profound impact on my ability to manage narcolepsy and enhance my well-being is truly commendable.

As an extra bonus. If you have a question the developers and team are actually so happy to engage with their customers, fans, and community that you can feel them genuinely providing their portal of information to you.
